description: Set the system date, time, and/or timezone on a MikroTik router. Idempotent: returns already_set if the values already match. Supports dry-run.

date.description: Date in RouterOS format: mon/dd/yyyy (e.g. jan/02/2006)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: set_system_clock
title: Set System Clock
